vsftpd 2.3.4.note: Known backdoored version (CVE-2011-2523) — grants unauthenticated root access
vsftpd 2.3.4.recommendation: Upgrade vsftpd immediately; verify binary integrity against official checksums

UnrealIRCd.note: Historically shipped with a backdoored download (2010 incident)
UnrealIRCd.recommendation: Verify source integrity and upgrade to a current signed release

OpenSSH 4.7p1.note: Very outdated OpenSSH release with multiple known CVEs
OpenSSH 4.7p1.recommendation: Upgrade to the latest stable OpenSSH release

telnetd.note: Telnet transmits credentials and data in plaintext

ProFTPD 1.3.1.note: Older ProFTPD releases have known remote code execution CVEs
ProFTPD 1.3.1.recommendation: Upgrade ProFTPD to the latest stable release

Samba smbd 3.X.note: Samba 3.x has multiple known remote code execution vulnerabilities
Samba smbd 3.X.recommendation: Upgrade Samba and restrict SMB exposure to trusted networks

MySQL 5.0.note: End-of-life MySQL release, no longer receives security patches
MySQL 5.0.recommendation: Upgrade to a supported MySQL/MariaDB version

VNC.note: VNC is often configured with weak or no authentication
VNC.recommendation: Enforce strong VNC authentication or tunnel over SSH

Apache httpd 2.2.note: End-of-life Apache release, missing modern security patches
Apache httpd 2.2.recommendation: Upgrade to a currently supported Apache release

default.note: Service version could not be matched to a known high-risk entry
default.recommendation: Manually verify this service is current and necessary
